message.content:
Here’s a classic list of ingredients you’ll need to make a traditional lasagna:

| Category | Ingredient | Typical Amount (per 9×13 inch pan) |
|----------|------------|-------------------------------------|
| **Lasagna noodles** | Regular or no‑boil lasagna sheets | 12–15 sheets |
| **Meat sauce** | Ground beef or a mix of beef & pork | 1½–2 lb (680–900 g) |
| | Onion, finely chopped | 1 medium |
| | Garlic cloves, minced | 2–3 cloves |
| | Crushed tomatoes or tomato sauce | 28 oz (800 g) |
| | Tomato paste | 2 Tbsp |
| | Olive oil | 2 Tbsp |
| | Salt, pepper, dried oregano, basil, red pepper flakes | to taste |
| | Optional: red wine, bay leaf, carrot or celery (finely diced) | ¼ cup wine, 1 bay leaf, ½ cup carrot/celery |
| **Ricotta mixture** | Ricotta cheese | 15 oz (425 g) |
| | Egg (helps bind) | 1 large |
| | Grated Parmesan | ½ cup (50 g) |
| | Fresh parsley or basil, chopped | 2 Tbsp |
| | Salt, pepper | to taste |
| **Bechamel sauce** | Butter | 4 Tbsp |
| | All‑purpose flour | 4 Tbsp |
| | Milk | 4 cups (950 ml) |
| | Nutmeg, salt, pepper | pinch nutmeg, to taste |
| **Cheese topping** | Shredded mozzarella | 2–3 cups (200–300 g) |
| | Grated Parmesan | ½ cup (50 g) |
| | Optional: shredded provolone or fontina | ½ cup (50 g) |

**Optional extras**  
- Sautéed spinach or mushrooms mixed into the ricotta layer  
- A splash of white wine or a dash of Worcestershire sauce in the meat sauce  
- A drizzle of olive oil over the top before baking  

With these ingredients, you can assemble the layers—no‑boil noodles, meat sauce, ricotta mixture, béchamel, and cheese—and bake until bubbly and golden. Enjoy!
